headline: Gold dips slightly today, silver steady near ₹1,64,900 per kg
summary: Today's change is tiny: 24k gold is down ₹1 per gram (about 0.01%) to ₹12,327, and silver is down ₹100 per kg to ₹1,64,900. Over the past 7 days gold has fallen about 5.7% and silver about 8.4%, and silver has dropped about 25% since 26 October, which is the start of the 32-day history we track. Likely drivers include a softer US dollar-linked gold price (spot is about 0.5% below today's rate) and a firmer rupee, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices have eased sharply over the past week, so buyers may compare rates across jewellers and add making charges and GST to their budget before deciding, as today's move alone is negligible.
